title: TImer opens up unexpectedly on long-finished comments
body:
Lately I've been encountering an issue I've never noticed before the recent updates, though it resembles a very minor one I had previously noticed, and may be the same as or related to one mentioned on the Wordpress.org support thread. 

In short, when returning to a comment thread where I have previously left and possibly edited a comment or more than one comment, I will find an old comment counting down from a very high number, far exceeding the normal 5-minute limit. 

For example:

![odd sce result 2](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6822649/10235014/70764424-684d-11e5-9934-cd16afa0e9b5.png)
Also:

![odd sce result](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/6822649/10235015/70770b02-684d-11e5-83cf-954ce724e9c7.png)

353 minutes to edit!

You seemed at WP.org to suggest that this problem had something do with caching. I cleared both browser and site caches, and it DID go away (since last night), but I'm wondering why it's only appearing lately: I've bee using SCE for years, and have never seen anything like it. The very minor problem that it resembles, that I have NOT recently seen, was that I would occasionally return to a thread and find the countdown suspended. It would then re-start and accelerate to the end.

I don't see this matter as one of great urgency, but I do think it would be worth solving.

title: hang on save when a comment_text filter uses 3 args
body:
I have added a filter for 'comment_text' based on the built in filter definition using 3 args. Your call to apply_filters in function get_comment_content, appx line 977, only sends two args to the function. This causes an internal server error on our IIS server (mismatched arg count basically).

I suggest adding a 3rd argument of an empty array (as defined in the base WP system) to solve the issue. Same issue applies to 'get_comment_text'. Any other addon that tries to use the 3rd arg will cause the same hang.

I've adjusted our code to only use 2 args, but thought you might like to know the cause of a hang problem.
